records.command:
set -eu
p=/etc/metrix/codeip-preview/control/authelia-configuration-4183d9355dd3.yml
s=/tmp/opencut-legitate-oidc-review.yml
expected=4e264fee03a46d246d0bb90646564663b7c81eefbc44617a80213b6df95b8f6d
[ "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$expected" ] || { echo 'Active configuration changed; stopped.'; exit 1; }
b="${p}.before-opencut-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
cp -p "$p" "$b"
rollback() { cat "$b" > "$p"; docker restart metrix-platform-authelia-1 >/dev/null || true; }
trap rollback ERR
cat "$s" > "$p"
docker restart metrix-platform-authelia-1 >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  health=$(docker inspect metrix-platform-authelia-1 --format '{{.State.Health.Status}}')
  if [ "$health" = healthy ]; then echo "Legitate is healthy; OpenCut client configuration installed. Backup: $b"; exit 0; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo 'Health check failed; restoring previous configuration.'
false
